requirements_summary: SMB e‑commerce SaaS wants hosted API for chat + FAQ embeddings. Key non-functional: configurable log/ prompt retention windows (prefer 30 days), tenant-level opt-out for prompt storage, clear deletion API + audit logs. Low to medium latency OK (p95 < 500ms), throughput modest (100 reqs/min). Cost sensitive; aim to keep running costs <= $1k/month in pilot. No on-prem/VPC required — prefer public cloud SaaS offering.
latency_throughput_targets: p95 latency < 500ms, steady throughput ~100 rps peak during sale events (burst tolerant)
model_preferences: open models ok; prefer non-training mode for hosted API; explicit guarantee that prompts are not used for model training unless opted-in
prompt_storage_policy_requested: configurable tenant-level retention (30/90/365), opt-out toggle for persisting user messages, immediate deletion API for legal requests, audit log entries for deletion activity
